name: Carnivore Square
source:
A group of friends in the spring of the 85s will discover a strange new reality in their world thanks to a gift bestowed upon Bennet by a supernatural being: the ability to open doors through space. Now he has to fight against other individuals like himself. However, the only way to win is to avoid succumbing to madness.
